note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Dimarco wins' / 'crunching tackle' (the ball won) through 'Straight away' / 'Denzel Dumfries' (his charge), 'The pass' and 'clean through' (the through ball) to 'he sets up' and 'Lautaro Martínez' (the finish). Chapter 2 is the slow replay of the charge; chapter 3 keys 'an easy finish' and 'for Lautaro'; chapter 4 keys the lesson words. Every cue starts with a plain word.

chapters.label: The charge, live
chapters.text: Milan, May 2025: Inter against Barcelona, a Champions League semi-final. Dimarco wins the ball with a crunching tackle. Straight away, Denzel Dumfries sprints forward. The pass sends him clean through, and he sets up Lautaro Martínez to score!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. The moment Inter win the ball, Dumfries runs, forward into the space behind the defence.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: From behind the goal: an easy finish for Lautaro. Inter won four three, after extra time.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when your team wins the ball, sprint forward on the outside to stretch the defence!
